doc.name: grey-ridge-live-sports-scores
doc.instructions: Live and same-day sports scores across 20+ sports from TheSportsDB, plus betting ODDS (point spread, over/under, moneyline from DraftKings via ESPN) for the major US + soccer leagues — all normalized to one cross-sport schema with a derived lifecycle status (scheduled / in_progress / final / postponed) and a freshness field (data_age_seconds = how stale the reading was when served). Keyless and free. Call get_live_scores for in-progress games, get_scores_by_date for a calendar day (UTC), get_odds for betting lines on a league, get_matchup for a one-call betting-research card on a single game (recent form + streak, head-to-head season series, against-the-spread record, and ESPN win-probability), list_odds_leagues for the odds-covered leagues, list_sports to discover score filters. Bulk / scheduled / multi-league pipelines with dataset storage are in see_also (hosted rail).

tools.name: get_live_scores
tools.description: Return currently in-progress games across all sports (or one sport). Each row carries home/away teams and scores, league, a derived status, the live clock/period marker, and data_age_seconds (source freshness at serve time). Keyless, free.

sport.description: Optional sport filter (e.g. "soccer", "basketball", "nfl", "nhl", "mlb"). Omit or "all" for every sport.

tools.name: get_scores_by_date
tools.description: Return all events on a calendar date (UTC, "YYYY-MM-DD"), optionally filtered to one sport. Same unified schema and freshness field as get_live_scores. Use for finals, fixtures, and a full day board. Keyless, free.

date.description: Calendar date in UTC, "YYYY-MM-DD". Defaults to today (UTC) if omitted.

sport.description: Optional sport filter. Omit for every sport.

tools.name: get_odds
tools.description: Return betting lines for a league's current scoreboard: point spread, over/under total, and home/away moneyline (single-book, DraftKings via ESPN), plus each team's win/loss record and the game status. Call with a league token (nfl, nba, nhl, mlb, epl, "la liga", ncaaf, ucl, ...). Lines appear once a game is posted by the book and are null before then. Keyless, free. Bulk/scheduled odds feeds are in see_also.

league.description: League token: nfl, nba, wnba, nhl, mlb, ncaaf, ncaam, ufc, epl, "la liga", bundesliga, "serie a", ligue1, ucl, uel, mls — or a raw ESPN path like "soccer/esp.1". Call list_odds_leagues for all.

tools.name: get_matchup
tools.description: One-call betting-research card for a SINGLE game: each team's recent form (last-5 result string, W-L record, and current streak), the head-to-head season series (series score + completed meetings), the against-the-spread record (US sports, once enough games exist), and ESPN's win-probability (US sports; soccer omits it). This is the depth an odds-watching agent would otherwise make four extra calls for. Pass the league token and the event_id returned by get_odds. Keyless, free. Bulk/scheduled research feeds are in see_also (hosted rail).

league.description: League token (nfl, nba, nhl, mlb, epl, "la liga", ncaaf, ucl, ...) or a raw ESPN path. Same tokens as get_odds; call list_odds_leagues for all.

event_id.description: The event_id from a get_odds row, e.g. "espn:401909976" (the "espn:" prefix is optional).

tools.name: get_injuries
tools.description: Return the current injury report for a league: player, team, position, status (Out, Day-To-Day, ...) and the latest short report note with its update time. Optionally filter to one team by name. Use before reading a betting line from get_odds. Keyless, free.

league.description: League token: nfl, nba, nhl, mlb, ncaaf, epl, ... or a raw ESPN path. Call list_odds_leagues for all.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Return the latest headlines for a league (headline, one-line summary, publish time, link). Use for breaking context such as suspensions or trades. Not an injury list: call get_injuries for that. Keyless, free.

league.description: League token: nfl, nba, nhl, mlb, ncaaf, epl, ... or a raw ESPN path.

tools.name: list_odds_leagues
tools.description: List the league tokens get_odds understands (US majors + top soccer leagues) with their sport and ESPN path. Keyless, free.

tools.name: list_sports
tools.description: List the sport filters the score tools understand (canonical labels + common aliases like nba/nfl/nhl/mlb). Keyless, free.
